clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore, young hunters gather Battleboar Flanks from beasts threatening tauren hunting grounds. The meat feeds the tribe's youth.

Bristleback quilboar train battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine to enter tauren hunting grounds. Their attacks threaten the young tauren at Camp Narache. Grull Hawkwind sends novice hunters to take the flanks and snouts from the beasts they kill. The flank meat is cooked into stew for the tribe's youth, feeding them with what the quilboar sent against their people.
